quotes: While within the sanctum, the Quaesitor and any of their agents are under forfeit immunity.

entries.title: Compensation for Quaesitors
entries.summary: How vis spent on an investigation and a seasonal rate are repaid from Tribunal coffers or by an unfounded complainant, and the share of fines for a Quaesitor who also prosecutes.
quotes: Three pawns per season is a typical figure, but this will vary between sagas and Tribunals.

entries.title: Tokens and Shards
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: The Tribunal's social currency: tokens credit service to the polity, shards debit antisocial acts, tokens may neutralize shards for a season of service, and shards expose a citizen to ostracism.
quotes: The principle use of the tokens is neutralization.
Being found guilty of a High Crime (three per crime in addition to any other penalty);
Any citizen possessing one or more shards is liable to the vote of ostracism

entries.title: Other Tasks for the Common Good
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Sidebar listing the extra tasks the Tribunal may ask volunteers to perform, each earning a token on success.
quotes: Any magus who volunteers and successfully completes the job is awarded a token.

entries.title: Decrees of Defamation
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: A citizen can accuse another of acting against the polity's unity; success gives the accused a shard, failure gives one to the accuser.
quotes: If the Assembly finds in favor of the decree, then the accused is credited with one shard.

entries.title: Decrees of Contrition
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: A shard-bearing magus may offer reparation and apology to have the shard removed; the offering's size is the magus's own choice and is kept if the plea fails.
quotes: The magnitude of the reparation is determined by the magus himself.

entries.title: Ostrakismos (ostracism)
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Closing business of the Assembly: citizens holding shards may be voted as candidates, the majority name on potsherds is ostracised and exiled from the Tribunal for a time.
quotes: He cannot return to Thebes for seven years

entries.title: Urban Covenants and the Town Sene
entries.summary: Background and precedent (Fudarus versus Atramentum, 1200) for how Tribunal law handles covenants interacting with autonomous towns.

entries.title: The Town Senex
entries.summary: The covenant nearest a town, judged by whose church bells sound loudest, is the senex and has superior rights in that town over other covenants' agents.
quotes: The Tribunal of 1200 determined that the agents of the covenant closest to a town, referred to as the senex, have superior rights to those of the agents of other covenants operating in that town.
The senex is judged to be the covenant in which the town's church bells sound the loudest, as determined by a Quaesitor.

entries.title: Urban Covenants (Town Charters and Fealty)
entries.summary: A covenant may be sited in a town and hold a mundane town charter and pay collective tax, but magi cannot use charter privileges, vote or hold office because that would amount to swearing fealty.
quotes: However, the magi themselves cannot take advantage of any privileges under the charter, as to do so would be effectively the same as swearing an oath of fealty.

entries.title: A Covenant Charter
entries.summary: Why a covenant benefits from a grant of charter: it formally limits what mundane lords can demand of the covenant.

entries.title: Implications of the Senex and Urban Covenant Rulings
entries.summary: Notes that the senex ruling can decide ownership of unclaimed urban vis sources, that senex rights depend on how far bells carry, and that seeking mundane charters is encouraged.

entries.title: Folios
entries.summary: What a folio is, when and where the Colentes Arcanorum compile it, and how it is copied and circulated through the Order.
quotes: Folios are collections of Laboratory Texts and tractatus compiled by the Colentes Arcanorum

entries.title: Editorial Disagreements
entries.summary: Optional contest rolled between characters who argue over which texts go into a folio, using Presence + Leadership or Communication + Artes Liberales plus House Acclaim.
quotes: Loud characters may make a Presence + Leadership stress roll.
Crafty characters may make a Communication + Artes Liberales stress roll.

entries.title: The Library of the Normandy Tribunal
entries.summary: Magi who donate an original book to the Tribunal library win a guaranteed Tourney prize of a leased book of similar quality, with certamen to settle clashes over the same book.
quotes: Contributing an original book to the Tribunal's library grants a magus an automatic prize at the next Tourney, the lease of a book of similar quality to the one offered.
a character may chose a book that is worth up to as many Covenant Build Points as the one he contributed

entries.title: The Library of the Tribunal (Book Leases)
entries.summary: Rules for books won as Tourney prizes: seven-year exclusive lease, the leaseholder's duty to keep and return the book to Confluensis, and the Cow and Calf Oath on copies.
quotes: Winning a book in the tournament grants exclusive access to that tome for a total of seven years
Books are leased under a Cow and Calf Oath

related.text: Covenants p.95 Cow and Calf Oath

entries.title: Fenicil's Rituals (Guernicus Group Rituals)
entries.requires: House Guernicus (rituals taught by Guernicus magi); not available to the Unstructured Caster flaw
entries.summary: Rules for the pre-Mercurian group rituals kept by House Guernicus: learned from a teacher in a season without a lab total, cast by a group leader whose Casting Total sums the group's Ability scores, protected by Wizard's Vigil spells, and costing vis equal to the ritual's Ease Factor (partly substitutable with costly materials).
quotes: Sta + [Sum of Ability Scores] + Aura Modifier + Die Roll
Each ritual requires a number of pawns of vis equal to its Ease Factor.

entries.title: Greater Rituals (Fenicil)
entries.summary: Greater rituals take a whole season to enact and are treated as a lab activity for time commitment; they require large gatherings at Magvillus and may not work at all.
quotes: These rituals take a whole season to enact. Treat as a lab activity in terms of time commitment.

entries.title: Greater Ritual Example (Curse of Thoth)
entries.summary: A worked example of a Greater Ritual Casting Total, showing how the group's summed Abilities, the leader's Stamina, the aura and a die roll combine, how Penetration is found against the Ease Factor, and the vis and silver consumed.

entries.title: Lesser Rituals (Fenicil)
entries.summary: Lesser rituals see occasional use and take minutes per point of Ease Factor to cast; the listed examples are only a selection and the storyguide may add more.
quotes: All these rituals take five minutes for each point of Ease Factor to cast.

entries.title: Common Vis Sources
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Vis from shrines and certain mythic sites belongs to the polity, is gathered by volunteers for a token, and funds Longevity Rituals, items and the Ceremony of Propitiation.
quotes: In total, the Tribunal harvests approximately 50 pawns of vis from such sources each year.

entries.title: Provision of Longevity Rituals
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Each year the Tribunal sponsors one Longevity Ritual for the eligible citizen with the most tokens, who surrenders them; crafting it earns the maker tokens.
quotes: Every year, the Tribunal sponsors a Longevity Ritual for a single Theban magus.
The applicant with the most tokens is chosen; she must surrender all these tokens

entries.title: Provision of Healing
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Customary duty to provide magical healing to a fellow magus, with the healer bearing the vis cost, a customary vis gift in return and a token awarded to the healer.
quotes: by tradition, the gift is usually half the amount that was required for the healing

entries.title: Gifts of Vis
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Describes informal customs of gifting vis for hospitality and healing, the etiquette penalties for stinginess or hoarding, and the ban on trading tokens or shards for vis.
quotes: The exchange of tokens or shards, the true "currency" of the Tribunal, for vis is not permitted.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.85

entries.title: Donation of Apprentices
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Finders of Gifted children must report them to the Treasury Council so the Apprentice Presentation can assign them rather than claiming them directly.
quotes: If a magus discovers a Gifted individual, he has a duty to notify the Treasury Council.

entries.title: Interviews with Apprentices
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Before the Tribunal, masters without shards may question Gifted children and bid for them by gifting tokens; Bonisagus may claim any child.
quotes: Bonisagus magi may immediately claim any of the presented apprentices.

entries.title: The Apprentice Presentation
entries.requires: Saga set in the Theban Tribunal
entries.summary: Formal assignment of Gifted children to masters by tokens gathered in the interviews, complaints against masters, token rewards for training without abuse, and the effect on apprenticeship length.
quotes: magi are awarded tokens for training an apprentice without abuse, one for the first seven years and another at Gauntlet

entries.title: Mundane Resources and Covenant Raiding
entries.summary: Explains why raiding another covenant's mundane resources is not a Hermetic crime in Normandy and gives storyguide advice on the consequences of raids, including the Poverty Hook and tracking yearly expenditures.
quotes: Raids should be primarily a source of stories, but may result in the gain or loss of supplies.

entries.title: Rulings on Mundane Resources and Raiding
entries.summary: Lists what counts as a magus's magical power (protected) and what does not (raidable), and the conduct rules for a raid: no damage to buildings, no Code breaches, and certamen against accompanying magi.
quotes: food, consumables, building supplies, arms and armor, and luxury goods are not part of a magus's magical power
The raiding maga must challenge any accompanying magi to certamen; should she lose then she must abandon her raid.

entries.title: Cross-Border Disputes
entries.summary: Foreign magi raiding into Normandy fall under the Normandy Peripheral Code, and the Tribunal's only recourse is to judge them harshly if they break the Code.
quotes: when in Normandy they are under the jurisdiction of the Normandy Peripheral Code

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.56

entries.title: Merinita: Faerie Magic
entries.requires: House Merinita: Initiation into Faerie Magic (must be touched by the fay)
entries.summary: Merinita initiates are attuned to Magic and Faerie auras (no Warping or extra botch dice from either) and gain special Ranges, Durations and Targets (Road, Bargain, Fire, Until (Condition), Year + 1, Bloodline) usable only by Faerie Magic characters.
quotes: A character may not be Initiated into this mystery unless she has been touched by the fay.
To calculate the level of a Bargain spell, calculate the level of the spell that takes effect when the bargain is broken, and add three magnitudes.

entries.title: Faerie Magic Ability
entries.requires: House Merinita: Initiation into Faerie Magic
entries.summary: The Faerie Magic Ability can stand in for Magic Theory when experimenting or working with faerie vis, raises the vis usable in a season for faerie vis, and adds botch dice that cause Warping Points without forcing Twilight checks.
quotes: The amount of vis you can use in a single season is equal to your (Magic Theory + Faerie Magic) x 2, so long as all of it is faerie vis.

entries.title: Charms
entries.requires: House Merinita: Initiation into Faerie Magic
entries.summary: Charms are sympathetic casting aids (objects, performances or pronouncements) made with an artistic roll that raise the Penetration Multiplier when the maga has an Arcane Connection; temporary charms are used once, permanent charms need a special object.
quotes: The maga produces an effective charm on a roll of 6+, or 9+ for a permanent charm.
increasing her Penetration Multiplier by two

entries.title: House Ex Miscellanea: Compulsory Tradition Virtues and Flaws
entries.summary: Every magus Ex Miscellanea gets a compulsory Major non-Hermetic Virtue, Major Hermetic Flaw and Minor Hermetic Virtue for his tradition, in addition to the normal allocation; this section explains what each represents and which Virtues and Flaws are typical.
quotes: All members of this House have their particular tradition represented by a Major non-Hermetic Virtue, a Major Hermetic Flaw, and a Minor Hermetic Virtue (ArM5, page 30).
Note that Hermetic Virtues and Flaws, including the ones gained by being a member of House Ex Miscellanea, affect only the exercise of Hermetic magic, not non-Hermetic powers.

entries.title: Magi Ex Miscellanea Without a Major Supernatural Ability
entries.summary: Allows the compulsory Major non-Hermetic Virtue of a magus Ex Miscellanea to be something other than a Supernatural Ability, and sets limits on designing such Virtues.
quotes: New Supernatural Virtues that are not controlled by an Ability score should be designed following the rules for effects instilled into items, complete with uses per day, and should not exceed seventh magnitude.

entries.title: Magi Orbi
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea (exile from another House)
entries.summary: How to create a magus orbus, an exile from another House who joined House Ex Miscellanea, built with the former House's rules but without its privileges and Mystery Cults, and with an Orbus Reputation.
quotes: A magus orbus has a Hermetic Reputation as an Orbus at a score of 2, and probably avoids his former colleagues.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Mystery Cults pp.52, 73
Guardians of the Forests: The Rhine Tribunal pp.62-64

entries.title: Magvillus Council
entries.summary: Composition, quorum and decision rules of the inner and outer tiers of the council that governs House Guernicus and sits in judgment on wider matters.
quotes: An attendance of twenty-one is considered quorum.

entries.title: Guernicus Apprenticeship and Gauntlet
entries.summary: Describes how Guernicus apprentices are trained (moral philosophy, investigation Abilities such as Folk Ken, Awareness and Intrigue) and how the House gauntlet tests them, including a secret test of honesty that decides whether the apprentice may become a Quaesitor.
quotes: If an apprentice is dishonest three times, he will be allowed to enter House Guernicus, but not as a Quaesitor.

entries.title: Guernicus Politics and Advancement
entries.summary: Explains how Quaesitors rise in the House and Tribunal through reputation and noteworthy successes, from adviser to Presiding Quaesitor to the inner Magvillus council, and how the House's policy of posting new magi to distant Tribunals affects careers.
quotes: A competent Quaesitor can expect at least one term as Presiding Quaesitor during his career.

entries.title: Electing the Primus (Jerbiton)
entries.summary: Procedure for choosing and dismissing the Jerbiton Primus: nomination, hourly ballots eliminating the lowest candidate, proxies, and a petition of one-third of the House to dismiss.
quotes: A maximum of fourteen hourly ballots are taken in a day.
The Primus can be dismissed by one-third of the members of the House requesting that he resign.

entries.title: League Membership
entries.summary: Explains Jerbiton leagues, the interest-based clubs most Jerbiton magi belong to, and how they accept other-House members and fit into saga pacing.

entries.title: Designing a League
entries.summary: Options a troupe can choose when building a league: desired stories, senior connections, headquarters, a shared Reputation bonus, assistance and a name, with a worked example.
quotes: All Reputations act as if they were 3 points higher, between colleagues.

entries.title: Converts to the Order (hedge wizards joining Hermes)
entries.requires: Hedge wizard character who swears the Oath of Hermes (House Ex Miscellanea)
entries.summary: How to build a Gifted hedge wizard who has converted to the Order: use the tradition's creation rules up to the Oath, then continue as a Hermetic magus, with limits on learning the Hermetic Arts and social consequences of the conversion.
quotes: Once the character has sworn the Oath of Hermes he gains the free Social Status Virtue Hermetic Magus

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Societates, House Ex Miscellanea

entries.title: UnGifted Hedge Wizards and the Order
entries.requires: unGifted hedge wizard seeking membership in the Order
entries.summary: Explains why membership is normally restricted to Gifted characters, the rare exceptions, and what an unGifted member could never do; includes the sample spell The Numbness of The Gift for sensing the Gift.
quotes: Membership in the Order of Hermes is restricted to characters with The Gift.

entries.title: Induction of Hedge Wizards into the Order
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix (inducting maga)
entries.summary: Procedure for bringing a Gifted hedge wizard into the Order: a short apprenticeship in Hermetic basics, an attempt to open the Arts that may destroy non-Hermetic powers, a season teaching the Parma Magica, then the Oath. Explains the Flaws and Gifted Companion status that can result.
quotes: typically lasting less than five years
The Pralician maga need not have all Arts above 5 for this process

entries.title: Joint Training of Apprentices
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea: Lineage of Pralix
entries.summary: Describes the arrangement in which a Pralician teaches Hermetic magic to a hedge wizard's apprentice in exchange for laboratory assistance, producing an apprentice trained in both traditions.
quotes: for every season the Pralican spends teaching Hermetic magic to her colleague's apprentice, she gets two seasons of the apprentice's assistance in the laboratory

entries.title: Joining House Flambeau (Gauntlet by combat)
entries.summary: How a candidate joins House Flambeau: finding a sponsor, a public combat-oriented Gauntlet judged by the sponsor, failure consequences, direct acceptance and the initiation ceremony.
quotes: By the Peripheral Code, an apprentice who fails his Gauntlet three times is given his fourth by a Quaesitor.

entries.title: Option: Variant House Benefits
entries.summary: Optional rule restricting the Flambeau free Minor House Virtue to Puissant Art (Ignem or Perdo), with substitutions allowed for the Ramius, Sebastian and Vilano schools.
quotes: This free Virtue must be either Puissant Art (Ignem) or Puissant Art (Perdo).

entries.title: New Supernatural Ability: Persona
entries.summary: Defines the Persona Supernatural Ability, which lets a character change into a number of full alternate identities by a roll, and what does and does not change when he does.
quotes: Adopting a different identity requires one round of concentration and a roll of Stamina + Persona against an Ease Factor of 9.

entries.title: Personae (Persona Supernatural Virtue)
entries.summary: Explains how a magus with the Persona Virtue gains personae with a starting Reputation, how Persona experience carries over to their Reputations, what a persona cannot do, and how the magic is detected and counted as an equivalent spell level.
quotes: at the moment of transformation it can be detected as if it were a Muto Corpus spell of 10th level, but for every sunset or sunrise that passes after adopting the persona, the magnitude drops by one.
the equivalent spell level is equal to five times the score in the Ability

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages p.71

entries.title: Masks for Parisian Stories
entries.requires: Covenant of the Normandy Tribunal with agents in Paris
entries.summary: Lists which Normandy covenants have established influence in which sections of Parisian society and explains why proxy battles between masks are now illegal there because Eboris is senex of Paris.
quotes: These disruptions, usually provoked by Tytalus magi, are now illegal because Eboris is the senex of Paris.

entries.title: Masks Within the Church
entries.summary: Notes that churchmen make useful masks because the Church mediates the Divine, and that French churchmen are less tied up with House Jerbiton than churchmen in the east or Italy.

entries.title: Mythic Blood (Birna and Great Beast bloodlines)
entries.summary: Explains how bearers of Birna's or a Great Beast's blood gain a Minor Magical Focus, a magical feat and a hereditary Personality Flaw, always with a bear heartbeast for Birna's line.

entries.title: Examples of Mythic Blood
entries.summary: Table of example Mythic Blood lines with the magical feat, Minor Magical Focus and Personality Flaw each confers.

entries.title: Other Modifications (head binding)
entries.summary: Head binding and similar rituals done in infancy give an aptitude for a particular path, which is a bonus to the Initiation Script for the first station on that path.
quotes: This acts as a +3 bonus for his Initiation Script for the first station (Mystery Virtue) of that path.

entries.title: The Lineage of Irmele
entries.summary: Describes a wandering Bonisagus lineage in the Rhine whose members travel as peregrinatores, tend to weather magic, are strong in Arts and rich in vis, and often rely on spontaneous magic for lack of a laboratory.
quotes: Once they achieve the status of master, they will, unlike others, typically remain a peregrinator for a couple of decades

related.text: Laws of Hospitality and the Peregrinatores

entries.title: Hedge wizards and Certamen
entries.requires: Hedge wizard facing a certamen challenge
entries.summary: Hedge wizards cannot take part in certamen unless their Hermetic Arts are Opened; a hedge wizard who accepts a challenge simply loses, which makes converts targets for bullying.
quotes: he cannot cause his phantasm to manifest

entries.title: Pralicians and Scrying
entries.summary: Explains how using Comprehend Magic on another magus counts as scrying under the Code of Hermes, and when a Tribunal is likely to convict.
quotes: Using Comprehend Magic against another magus is scrying, and forbidden by the Code of Hermes

entries.title: Red and Black Libraries
entries.summary: Describes the Quaesitorial Red Library (sigils of Renounced magi and spells used for Hermetic crimes) and Black Library (books it is a crime to own), and the vault with a Divine aura that houses them.
quotes: The Red and Black Libraries are stored in a vault consecrated by the bones of a virgin martyr, with a Divine Aura of 3.
these spells can be cast with impunity on hedge magicians, members of the Order of Odin or the Order of Solomon, or Renounced magi.

entries.title: Lictors
entries.requires: Role: lictor / hoplite in the Transylvanian Tribunal
entries.summary: Explains lictors (hoplites serving long term), the aid they may demand from Transylvanian covenants, and their badge of office, whose forgery is a serious crime.
quotes: Lictors have a duty to protect Quaestiores and follow their instructions.
lictors have a right to expect reasonable aid from any cives, soci, foederatus, or colona.
Carrying a facsimile of a lictorial badge is a serious crime.

entries.title: Kezdö Válasz Obligations and Methods
entries.summary: Explains the members' pledge to drop everything and respond to threats, their signalling charms with enough Penetration to pass Parma Magica, their rapid-travel methods, and the annual meeting where vexillations are announced.
quotes: Kezdö Válasz has approximately 55 grogs in total.
each is constructed with enough Penetration to pass through the magus' Parma Magica

entries.title: Mercere House in the Transylvanian Tribunal
entries.summary: Explains Mercere's special arrangement in this Tribunal: members do not vote unless Gifted, Redcaps are numerous and disputed, spouses may be styled Redcaps, and vampire-blooded children are recruited.
quotes: House Mercere's members in the Tribunal do not vote unless they are Gifted
Formally speaking there are only fifteen Redcaps in all of Transylvania.

entries.title: Mutantes (Lineage and Magic-Taming)
entries.requires: House Mercere (Mutantes lineage) or Mutantum-related Virtues
entries.summary: Describes the Mutantes lineage and its magic-taming philosophy, outlining boosting, harnessing and tethering, the Virtues and Flaws that grant these abilities to other magi, and the three matching mastered spell abilities Mutantes can teach.
quotes: By spending a pawn of vis when casting boosted spells or activating a boosted effect in an item, you may increase the Range, Duration, Target, or size of the effect by one magnitude.

entries.title: The Church
entries.summary: How the Order and the Church relate: no official contact, and Tribunals treat interfering with the Church as a very serious crime, so attacks on it risk Renouncing.
quotes: Tribunals tend to treat interfering with the Church as a very serious crime

entries.title: The Code of Hermes and the Guan
entries.summary: Discusses whether the Code of Hermes protects the Guan from Hermetic interference, since they serve hedge-magician kings whom the Order may demand to submit.
quotes: The servants of magicians are the property of those magicians, and may be legitimately targeted.

entries.title: The Chronicle (encyclopedia and fact lookup)
entries.summary: Treats the Chronicle volumes as tractatus in Order of Hermes Lore and Code of Hermes and gives a roll to look up a fact, with a bonus for each block of years of records accessed.
quotes: Intelligence + Order of Hermes Lore (or Code of Hermes) + stress die roll against an Ease Factor
every complete 50 years of The Chronicle to which he has access

entries.title: Earning the Rank of Archmage
entries.requires: Rank: Master (Rhine magus), 7th magnitude spell, great deed, successful archmage challenge
entries.summary: Sets out the requirements for archmagehood, including the challenge each archmage sets, the limits on challenging and granting the title, and the Rhine privileges of archmagi (extra proxy sigils and automatic victory in disputes against lower ranks).
quotes: they are permitted to hold the voting sigils of two retired magi
no archmage may grant the title to more than seven magi
a magus must have invented a spell of at least 7th magnitude

entries.title: Decorations
entries.summary: Describes the decorations worn by Transylvanian magi for service to the Tribunal, what earns each one, and that a decoration is never awarded twice and is replaced by a higher one.
quotes: Decorations are not repeated.
Parsley: This decoration is awarded for landing the mortal blow upon a magus expelled from the Order by the Tribunal.

entries.title: Calling a Wizard's March
entries.summary: A Quaesitor can declare a March outside Tribunal for an immediate threat such as a diabolist; the next Tribunal reviews it and the Quaesitor may not profit from it.
quotes: By Grand Tribunal ruling, no Quaesitor can materially benefit in any way from calling a Wizard's March.

entries.title: The Curantis
entries.summary: Describes the Tribunal officer elected to inspect and repair zenodochia, his legal powers, vis salary, term limits and his Notary.
quotes: The Curantis spends about a season each year traveling the zenodochia network.
A character may not serve two successive terms as Curantis.
